trackedGaps.summary: Economy.toJSON() omits _pendingReturns, cancelledReturns and cancellationReasons, so saving during the dwell loses the queued return trip. No crash or corruption; the trip is simply lost.
trackedGaps.reproducer: Complete an outbound trip (pendingReturnCount becomes 1), call eco.toJSON(), then Economy.fromJSON() -> pendingReturnCount is 0 and data.pendingReturns is undefined.
trackedGaps.impact: Minor gameplay gap: a save/load mid-dwell silently cancels a return leg. Becomes more visible once S06.1 adds real journey accounting, which is why it must be fixed before then.
trackedGaps.actionWhenFixed: Add pendingReturns, cancelledReturns and cancellationReasons to the v2 snapshot, restore them in fromJSON, and flip the two characterization tests in test/returnDispatch.test.js to assert survival across a save/load.

trackedGaps.summary: A road segment shorter than NODE_SNAP (18 wu) cannot be built at all: the far endpoint snaps back onto the existing node, so addRoad silently creates nothing and returns empty nodeIds/edgeIds.
trackedGaps.reproducer: net.addRoad([[0,0],[10,0]]) then net.addRoad([[10,0],[20,0]]) -> second call returns {nodeIds:[], edgeIds:[]} and the graph still has 1 edge.
trackedGaps.impact: Silent no-op rather than an explained rejection. Blocks short connector and slip-lane segments, which S04.3 needs.
trackedGaps.actionWhenFixed: Reject with an explicit reason, or make snapping direction-aware so a short forward segment is buildable. Remove the 18 wu minimum from the S01.1 test helpers' comments once resolved.

notes: Created: src/roadProfiles.js (roadDimensions, laneCenterOffset, outerLaneOffset, ROAD_PRESETS, CAR_HALF_WIDTH), test/roadDimensions.test.js, scripts/capture-road-classes.mjs. Modified: src/roadNetwork.js (imports the profile model, derives ROAD_CLASS width/lanesPerDir/laneW from it at load, laneOffset/lanePoint delegate, roundabout max-arm-width and ring class use roadDimensions), src/render.js (casing, shadow, fill, lane dashes, centreline, road preview and congestion overlay all use roadDimensions), src/main.js (exposed renderer on __rf so visual tests can set the camera precisely).

IMPORTANT CORRECTION: the lane offsets were already correct. The real defect was a too-narrow pavement (hand-chosen 11/16/24 that did not follow from the lane formula). My first mutation reverted the offset and proved nothing; the accurate mutation reverts the width. Recorded in EVIDENCE E02 so the wrong half of the inconsistency is not re-tested.

Lane divider dashes are now positioned from the same lane-centre model that places vehicles, so a dash always sits exactly between two lanes rather than at a hard-coded offset. Centreline is omitted on one-way roads, which have no centre division.

ROAD_CLASS.width/lanesPerDir/laneW are recomputed from roadProfiles at module load rather than deleted, so existing callers and the original test asserting highway > avenue > street width keep working without a second source of truth.

capture-road-classes.mjs initially placed roads at world y=-260, which mapped to screen y=140 - under the HUD card - so the clicks hit the HUD and no road was built. Fixed by framing the camera so the road band maps to screen y=400, clear of the HUD and the bottom dock. Also added a spine road so all three classes carry vehicles rather than only the nearest one.
The renderer hook on __rf is read/write for tests only; gameplay never reads from __rf.
